### `vc create`

Start or schedule a video chat, livestream or RTMP stream in a chat.

Needs `manage_call`. A chat has one call at a time: creating a new one ends the old one, which is why it asks.

```
tlgr vc create <CHAT> [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · destructive (needs `--yes` off a TTY) · returns `GroupCallCreated`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CHAT` | chat | yes | Where to start it. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--rtmp` | flag |  | RTMP mode: one external encoder publishes all media. |
| `--schedule` | datetime |  | Schedule it instead of starting. |
| `--title` | text |  | Call title; defaults to the chat name. |

```console
$ tlgr vc create @newsroom --json
```

### `vc download`

Archive a livestream or live story to disk (stream-mode chunks).

Join the call first (`vc join --listen-only`): chunk fetches fail with GROUPCALL_JOIN_MISSING otherwise.

```
tlgr vc download <CALL> [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · returns `StreamDownload`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL` | text | yes | A chat, id:access_hash or call link. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--audio-only` | flag |  | Fetch only the audio segments. |
| `--channel` | int |  | Video channel; omit for audio only. |
| `--duration` | duration | `30` | Stop after this much media. |
| `--out` | path |  | Output file. |
| `--quality` | int | `1` | Video quality: 0 lowest. |
| `--scale` | int |  | Segment scale; 0 is 1000ms. |
| `--since` | text | `live` | Start at the live edge or a timestamp. |

```console
$ tlgr vc download @newsroom --out /tmp/stream.ogg --json
```

### `vc end`

End a video chat, livestream, live story or conference for everyone.

Irreversible: the call becomes `groupCallDiscarded`.

### `vc get`

Everything about a group call: state, recording, limits, stream channels, donors.

`CALL` accepts a chat, `id:access_hash`, a t.me video-chat or `t.me/call/<slug>` link, or `msg:<id>` for an invitation.

```
tlgr vc get <CALL> [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `GroupCall`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL` | text | yes | A chat, id:access_hash, a call link, or msg:<id>. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `--check-sources` | int |  | Ask which of these sources are still joined. |
| `--donors` | flag |  | Add Stars donated and top donors. |
| `--limits` | flag |  | Add the app-config caps. |
| `--stream-channels` | flag |  | Add the live stream channels and the live edge. |

```console
$ tlgr vc get @newsroom --json
```

### `vc join`

Join a group call — control plane only, no audio is sent or received.

`--listen-only` is experimental: the server's acceptance of a synthesized payload is not documented. It exists because joining is a hard prerequisite for `vc download`.

```
tlgr vc join <CALL> [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · returns `GroupCallJoined`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL` | text | yes | A chat, id:access_hash or call link. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--block` | path |  | E2E join block. |
| `--invite-hash` | text |  | Speaker link hash: grants can_self_unmute. |
| `--listen-only` | flag |  | Synthesize a listener payload. Experimental — see the docs. |
| `--muted/--unmuted` | flag | `True` | Join muted. |
| `--params-json` | path |  | tgcalls join payload. |
| `--public-key` | text |  | int256 E2E key (conferences). |
| `--remember` | flag |  | Store --send-as as the chat's default. |
| `--send-as` | chat |  | Appear as yourself or a channel. |
| `--video-stopped/--no-video-stopped` | flag | `True` | Join with video off. |

```console
$ tlgr vc join @newsroom --listen-only --json
```

### `vc leave`

Leave a group call (it keeps running for everyone else).

After leaving a conference the remaining participants still have to prune you from the E2E chain — `conference remove --left-only`.

```
tlgr vc leave <CALL> [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | int |  | SSRC you joined with; 0 for a listener. |

### `vc mute`

Mute yourself, force-mute a participant, or silence someone just for you.

Self-mute flips a server-side flag; there is no microphone behind it, and `media` says so.

```
tlgr vc mute <CALL> [PEER] [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · idempotent (reports `already`) · returns `MuteState`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL` | text | yes | A chat, id:access_hash or call link. |
| `PEER` | chat | no | Whom; omit for yourself. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--for-me` | flag |  | Mute them only in your own playback (muted_by_you). |

```console
$ tlgr vc mute @newsroom --json
```

### `vc participant list`

The fourth conference state — present in the E2E chain with no media — needs a block parser tlgr does not have and is reported as null.

| `--source` | int |  | Only the owners of these SSRCs. |
| `--user` | chat |  | Only these participants. |

### `vc watch`

Stream live call state: participants, mutes, in-call messages, connection changes.

Conference messages arrive encrypted and are emitted as opaque blobs: decrypting them needs the E2E key tlgr cannot derive.

```
tlgr vc watch <CALL> [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `Page[GroupCallEvent]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL` | text | yes | A chat, id:access_hash or call link. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--idle-timeout` | duration | `3600` | Give up after silence. |
| `--messages/--no-messages` | flag | `True` | Include in-call messages. |
| `--participants/--no-participants` | flag | `True` | Include participant joins, leaves and mutes. |

```console
$ tlgr vc watch @newsroom --json
```

<details><summary>Catalog coverage (2 full, 0 partial)</summary>
